data.one_liner: A country picker widget to select a country, now re-exported from phone_form_field.
data.what_it_does: Provides a full-screen page or modal sheet for users to select a country, featuring extensive language localizations and accessibility support. Since version 3.0.0, the package acts as a thin re-export of the phone_form_field package.
use_when: You need a dedicated country selection interface in your app forms.
You want support for multiple localized country names and flags.
avoid_when: You are starting a new project and can just use phone_form_field directly.
You do not need a country picker widget.
strengths: Lots of supported languages for localization.
weaknesses: Merged into phone_form_field, so this package is now merely a thin wrapper/re-export.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up localizations delegates as described in the documentation.
